subject: Deal hygiene: ACME - confirm amounts, SKUs, and next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ellie Tan <ellie.tan@acme-corp.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Deal hygiene: ACME - confirm amounts, SKUs, and next steps

Team / Ellie,

Quick ask ahead of next week’s forecast: can we lock the following fields on the ACME opportunity so finance can include it in the Q2 commit? I pulled the last CRM export and there are a few mismatches.

Summary of what I need updated in the opportunity row (CRM export attached):
- Amount: ensure the finalized contract amount (not list price) is in the Amount field; current CRM shows $1,150,000 but procurement indicated negotiated net of discounts is $985,000.
- Product / SKUs: map the custom quote to Redwood SKU lines — specifically: 
  * Redwood-API-Std x3 (primary)
  * Opt-Cache (optional)
  * OnPrem-Connector license (one-time)
- Next step & owner: update Next Step to either "Legal Review" or "Final PO" and set owner to Rajiv Menon at Acme (he’ll own PO).
- Probability: sales should set a conservative probability reflecting procurement timing (suggest 60% unless Legal has sign-off).

Attachments: I attached the CRM export and our mutual action plan draft — please review and confirm edits inline.

Can you reply with the finalized Amount, exact SKU lines, and the updated Next Step by EOD Monday (May 10)? Finance will pull the headcount for the commit on Tuesday morning.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

Attachment stubs: acme_pipeline_export_20270508.csv (CSV export of opportunity), ACME_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.docx (MVP MAP)

From: Ellie Tan <ellie.tan@acme-corp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@acme-corp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deal hygiene: ACME - confirm amounts, SKUs, and next steps

Hi Ben / Logan,

Thanks for the clear list. Quick confirmations from procurement/legal side:
- Final Amount our CFO will approve is $985,000 (this includes the negotiated 14.4% discount and excludes the one-time connector professional services line which will be PO'd separately). Please use $985,000 as the committed ARR number.
- SKUs to mirror our purchase order:
  1) R-INF-API-STD-3 (3 seats) — maps to Redwood-API-Std x3
  2) R-INF-OPT-CACHE (feature add-on) — annual
  3) R-INF-ONPREM-CONN-1 (one-time license) — bill separately as non-recurring
- Next Step: "Legal sign-off / Final PO" — target owner: Rajiv Menon (rajiv.menon@acme-corp.com). Expected completion: 2027-05-18.
- Probability: Procurement recommends 65% until Legal has countersigned.

I uploaded a redline of the MAP with dates for Legal. If you prefer, Rajiv can be looped into a short call with Ben early next week to accelerate PO.

Best,
Ellie
Ellie Tan
Director, Procurement — Acme Corporation
ellie.tan@acme-corp.com

Attachment stub: ACME_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2_redline.docx

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellie Tan <ellie.tan@acme-corp.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deal hygiene: ACME - confirm amounts, SKUs, and next steps

On Sun, May 9, 2027 at 11:37 AM Ellie Tan <ellie.tan@acme-corp.com> wrote:
> Quick confirmations from procurement/legal side:
> - Final Amount... $985,000
> - SKUs...
> - Next Step: "Legal sign-off / Final PO"
> - Probability: 65%

Thanks Ellie — that’s the clarity we need. Team, two quick operational asks so finance can safely include ACME in the Q2 commit: 

1) Ben — please update the CRM opportunity row to the exact amount $985,000 and replace the free-text SKU lines with the canonical SKU codes Ellie provided (R-INF-API-STD-3, R-INF-OPT-CACHE, R-INF-ONPREM-CONN-1).
2) Marissa / Monica — once Ben updates CRM, please run a one-line validation on Monday afternoon to ensure Amount maps to the accounting ARR field and that the one-time license is flagged as non-recurring. Reply with "validated" in the thread so I can forward the snapshot to finance.
3) If Legal expects countersign changes beyond redlines in the doc, flag immediately and we’ll mark probability down for the commit.

I’ve attached a quick checklist you can paste into the CRM notes. Aim to close these items by 5pm PT Monday so Finance can pull the Q2 commit report on Tuesday 09:00 PT.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Regional Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com | +1 (917) 555-0199

- CRM Amount updated to $985,000 (field: committed_amount_usd).
